intro: Priestess Anetta is a human cleric of the Holy Light stationed inside Northshire Abbey. As a member of the Brotherhood of Northshire, she instructs newly arrived priests in their first sacred rites.

p: Priestess Anetta can be found on the ground floor of Northshire Abbey within its quiet library wing. Amid the threat of Defias bandits and kobolds troubling the valley, she serves as a grounding presence for the Brotherhood of Northshire, reminding all who pass not to turn their backs on the Light, for it may be the one thing that saves them someday.

Within the cloister, Anetta acts as the primary mentor for budding human priests. Novices who arrive with a hallowed letter of introduction seek her out to learn the fundamentals of faith: channeling holy words to mend flesh and unleashing smiting radiance to repel evil. Under her tutelage, young acolytes prepare to carry the Light beyond Northshire's secluded walls.
